chunks: And Hishām ibn Sālim narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, only forbade usury so that they would not refrain from acts of kindness.

key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury; unlawful increase in financial dealings
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: recognized good; kindness and benevolent conduct

ai.seo_question: Why did Allah forbid usury in this hadith from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ forbade riba to prevent people from withdrawing from beneficial and kind dealings with one another. It highlights that the prohibition of usury serves both a legal and moral purpose in preserving social good and mutual benevolence.
